meta.description: Free calculators and guides for Bangladesh investors: dividends, bonus shares, rights issues, profit and loss, position size, order types, government bond interest, bond vs bank deposit, treasury bond yields and auction dates.

header.headline: Free Investing Tools
header.subhead: Simple calculators and trackers for Bangladesh investors. Enter a few numbers and see what a dividend, a bonus or a government bond means for you.

items.situation: My share price fell after the record date
I am thinking about a government bond

groups.title: Dividends, Bonus and Rights Shares
groups.intro: Understand dividends, bonus shares, rights offers and what happens to your price.

tools.name: Dividend Calculator
tools.body: Work out your cash dividend after tax and your bonus shares from a company’s announcement.

tools.name: Dividend Income Goal Calculator
tools.body: Start with the dividend income you want and see how many shares it would take.

tools.name: Bonus Share Adjustment Calculator
tools.body: See why a price falls after the record date, how many shares you own, and your new cost price.

tools.name: Rights Issue Calculator
tools.body: See how many rights shares you can buy, what you pay, and how the offer changes your price.

groups.title: Trading Your Shares
groups.intro: Know your average cost, size your trades and pick the right order.

tools.name: Profit and Loss Calculator
tools.body: Add every buy of a stock to see your average cost and your profit or loss at any price.

tools.name: Position Size and Stop-Loss Calculator
tools.body: Decide how many shares to buy for the amount you are willing to lose.

tools.name: Which Order Type?
tools.body: Answer three questions to see which QuickTrade Pro order type fits what you want to do.

groups.title: Government Bonds
groups.intro: Plan bond interest and follow every Bangladesh Bank auction.

tools.name: Bond Interest Calculator
tools.body: Estimate the interest a Treasury Bond pays every 6 months, after the 10% AIT.

tools.name: Bond vs Bank Deposit Comparison
tools.body: See what a Treasury Bond and a bank fixed deposit pay you after tax, side by side.

tools.name: Treasury Bond Center
tools.body: The yield curve, the next auction and recent results, in one place.

tools.name: Auction Calendar
tools.body: Upcoming bond auctions with the date to apply by.

items.name: Valuation Ratios
items.body: P/E, price-to-book and dividend yield explained in plain language.

items.name: Corporate Events Calendar
items.body: Record dates, AGMs and rights issue dates for DSE companies in one place.

suggest.body: Have an idea for a tool?

items.a: Yes. All of our tools are free to use. You do not need an account or a BO Account.

No. They are estimates based on the numbers you enter, for education and information only. Companies, the Dhaka Stock Exchange and Bangladesh Bank decide the actual amounts, so always check the official announcement.

items.q: Where do the bond numbers come from?
items.a: Bond rates, dates and auction results come from Bangladesh Bank’s website.

items.q: Do the tools include trading fees?
items.a: No. They show the numbers for the dividend, bonus or bond itself and leave out fees and charges.

items.q: Can I trade after using a tool?
items.a: Yes. Open a BO Account online, then buy and sell stocks in QuickTrade Pro and apply for government bonds in the Midway Portal.

legal: Our tools give estimates for education and information only. They do not include fees or charges and are not investment or tax advice. Share prices can fall as well as rise, dividends and bond payments depend on the issuer, and you can lose some or all of the money you invest. No returns are guaranteed. Bond data on this site is taken from Bangladesh Bank’s website.
